market_summary: Nifty fell 0.61% to 25,144 on Fri 13 Nov (some feeds show 25,171) after October CPI inflation jumped to 6.09%, above the RBI's 6% ceiling, and Brent rose to about $95-98 on Gulf supply worries; it still gained 0.6% for the week, led by PSU banks (+7.5%), while IT fell 3.2%. Foreign investors bought a provisional ₹5,737 cr and domestic funds sold ₹2,254 cr on 13 Nov, extending the foreign buying streak to about ten sessions. India VIX eased about 6.5% to 15.5; WPI inflation data is due today, and higher inflation keeps rate-hike risk alive.

buy_ideas.name: Minda Corporation
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 revenue up 43% and profit up 69% year on year; revenue beat estimates by 10.7%. Growth from EV parts and digital displays. Emkay's target is about 26% above the price at the time of the call (price implied from that upside, 11 Nov).
buy_ideas.risks: Auto demand could slow if rates rise. Mid-cap, so it swings more. Price is implied from the 11 Nov upside, so check the live quote.

buy_ideas.name: Apollo Hospitals
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 revenue up 20.8% and profit up 32%, both above estimates. Defensive healthcare demand holds up better if inflation and rates rise. About 21% upside to target.
buy_ideas.risks: Valuation is already high, and new hospitals take time to fill. Price is implied from the 11 Nov upside.

buy_ideas.name: Lemon Tree Hotels
buy_ideas.target_source: Motilal Oswal (Buy); CLSA Outperform at ₹163 earlier in the week
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 revenue up 18% and profit up 64%, both well above estimates. Stock is up 5% in a week but Motilal still sees about 15% upside.
buy_ideas.risks: Hotel stocks are cyclical and sensitive to travel demand. Price is implied from Motilal's stated 15% upside (13 Nov).

buy_ideas.name: Va Tech Wabag
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 revenue up 22% and profit up 23%; record ₹20,207 cr order book gives multi-year visibility. About 17% upside to target.
buy_ideas.risks: Project delays and late customer payments. Price is implied from the 11 Nov upside.

buy_ideas.name: State Bank of India
buy_ideas.thesis: PSU banks led last week (index +7.5%) and SBI rose about 6% to near ₹1,080 after results. Management guides 14-15% loan growth; CLSA's target is about 23% above the current price.
buy_ideas.risks: Already up 6% in a week, so wait for a dip rather than chase. Goldman's target gives only about 5% upside. Rate hikes would squeeze some loan segments.

buy_ideas.name: Gujarat Fluorochemicals
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 revenue up 45.5% and profit up 35.8% year on year. About 11.5% upside to target.
buy_ideas.risks: Smaller upside than the others; chemicals pricing can swing. Price is implied from the 11 Nov upside.

avoid.reason: Results missed badly: Q2 profit fell 61% to ₹203 cr and revenue fell 29%, as international sales dropped 41%. Stay away until the export business recovers.

portfolio_notes.HINDALCO: Dropped from buy ideas today: no fresh news or live price found. Nuvama's ₹1,184 target from 6 Nov still stands; metals fell about 1% on 13 Nov.
portfolio_notes.SBIN: Up about 6% last week to near ₹1,080, so less upside than on 13 Nov. Still a buy on CLSA's target; avoid chasing.
portfolio_notes.KALYANKJIL: Hit a 52-week high of ₹718 after a 24.5% weekly jump. Motilal Oswal says Buy at ₹800 (about 15% upside), but adjusted profit growth is lower than the headline. Hold if owned; don't add after this spike.

portfolio_notes.RVNL: Q2 profit rose 8.3% to ₹250 cr. No estimates found to judge a beat or miss, so it's a hold, not a fresh buy.
